metadata.description: Agent Skills for Claude Code — spec-driven OpenSpec + TLA+ sub-agent workflow, and future skills.

plugins.name: dev-skills
plugins.description: Spec-driven OpenSpec + TLA+ sub-agent workflows: single-implementer (spec-author, design-gate, tla-checker, task-planner, implementer, verifier, optimizer) and parallel (adds an implementation-orchestrator that fans work across concurrent implementer agents). Includes opsx_show_design (engineering diagrams) and opsx_show_user_flows (persona flow diagrams) to visualize an OpenSpec change's design.
